thread:
Ellen (Support): Heads-up: customer AstraPay reports a sudden throughput collapse and surge in 503s during their peak at 11:02 UTC. They saw ~12% errors and long tail latencies.
Chris (Sales): AstraPay is on a paying pilot with a latency guarantee. They're upset and asked for immediate mitigation + ETA. Looping @Vera (PM).
Vera (PM): Thanks. Ellen, paste route, model variant, region, and any payload examples. Is there a deploy in the window?
Ellen (Support): Route: /v1/generate (astrapay-live). Model: redwood/gpt-xl-quant, typical seq ~480, client concurrency ~180, region eu-west-1. Snippet: `POST /v1/generate {"model":"redwood/gpt-xl-quant","input":"~450 tokens"}` -> 503s.
deploybot: Rollout v2026.08.02.11.00 -> eu-west-1 pool-12
Diego (Eng): Telemetry shows pod churn and memory pressure in pool-12 right after the rollout. Kernel scheduling tweak for large KV caches was in this deploy. Hypothesis: mem bump + high concurrency causes eviction and backlog.
Samir (Oncall): Confirmed OOMKilled events and ingress queue buildup at 11:03. Autoscaler attempted to add nodes but churned due to pod restarts.
Vera (PM): Triage options: (1) Per-route model fallback to fp16 variant (fast, minor output diff). (2) Route to a dedicated EU pool (good perf, provisioning ~40m). (3) Rollback heuristic globally (~1h, broader risk). We need to pick and have mitigation + comms.
Chris (Sales): AstraPay prefers minimal quality impact and minimal downtime. They asked for fallback first if that's low risk. They also want a canary and a postmortem.
Diego (Eng): I'll push a routing override for a canary (100 requests, 10%). If benchmark looks good we can flip to 100%. Patch: `PATCH /v1/routes/astrapay-live {"model_override":"redwood/gpt-xl-fp16","canary_requests":100,"canary_pct":10}`
Samir (Oncall): I set an alert: `astrapay_error_rate > 2% for 1m` -> page eng-oncall. Monitoring ingress latency, node OOMs, and pod restarts.
Ellen (Support): Canary executed. AstraPay reports initial 100 requests: p95 ~300ms, error rate 0.9% (was 12%). They accepted canary output for quality. Requested a 3-hour observation after full flip.
Vera (PM): Decision: perform fallback and monitor 3h. Parallel work: RCA P0 to debug kernel heuristic memory behavior; product P1 to spec auto-fallback routing policy; ops P1 to update deploy rollback runbook. Owners: Diego (RCA), Vera (auto-fallback spec), Samir (runbook), Chris/Ellen (customer comms).
Diego (Eng): Created ticket INF-6001. Acceptance for RCA: reproducible case in staging, targeted fix or config gating, and perf benchmark showing no regression. Due: 72h.
Vera (PM): Acceptance criteria for closure with customer: (a) AstraPay p95 < 400ms and error rate < 1% for continuous 3h, (b) RCA documented and remediation scheduled, (c) product spec for auto-fallback added to roadmap with prioritization.
Chris (Sales): Sending immediate status to AstraPay now and noting next update cadence hourly. Also flagging potential SLA credit risk to finance/legal.
Samir (Oncall): Keeping rota ready. If errors rise above 2% we'll escalate and consider capacity move to dedicated pool.
Diego (Eng): Promoting canary to 100% now. Logs/heapdumps uploaded to INF-6001.
Ellen (Support): AstraPay confirms traffic routed to fp16 variant; p95 ~360ms, errors 0.6%. They asked for hourly check-ins for the next 3h and a postmortem.
Vera (PM): Thanks team. We'll track INF-6001 and the product epic for auto-fallback. If rollback is needed later we'll coordinate via this thread. :white_check_mark:
